key_insight: FAMOSE uses the ReAct agent paradigm to autonomously generate, evaluate, and iteratively prune features, combining augmentation and optimal selection into a single automated loop that reduces reliance on human domain expertise.
problem_solved: Addresses the feature-engineering bottleneck for tabular data by searching an exponentially large feature space without extensive manual effort or domain knowledge.
method: ReAct-based agent alternates reasoning and acting to propose and modify candidate features automatically.
Integrated evaluation loop scores candidates using downstream model performance and selection criteria, then prunes or refines features.
Unified pipeline that combines feature augmentation (generation) with optimal selection (search/pruning) to converge on a compact, high-performing feature set.
impact: Makes feature discovery faster, more reproducible, and accessible to practitioners working with tabular data, improving model performance while reducing the need for expert hand-crafted features.
visual_elements: ReAct agent loop diagram showing Reason → Act → Evaluate → Update cycle for feature proposals
Before/after feature-space visualization (many raw candidates vs. compact selected feature set)
Bar or line chart comparing model performance: baseline features vs FAMOSE-selected features
Pipeline flowchart showing augmentation, evaluation, selection, and final model training
paper_title: FAMOSE: A ReAct Approach to Automated Feature Discovery
paper_authors: Keith Burghardt, Jienan Liu, Sadman Sakib, Yuning Hao, Bo Li
